I’m saving the controller script at the requested path and will leave the episode untouched.

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Vision/proprioception controller used for the RoboCasa365 TurnOffMicrowave run.
+
+The stop control is selected from the robot's right camera, then RGB-D camera
+calibration provides an approach point.  Arm motion is Cartesian visual servoing
+with a locally measured joint-to-end-effector Jacobian; no scene state or
+demonstration data is used.
+"""
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+CAM = "robot0_agentview_right"
+DT = 0.05
+
+
+def command_rows(q_targets, grip=-1.0):
+    """Build native joint-position rows from a sequence of 7-joint targets."""
+    a = np.zeros((len(q_targets), 13), dtype=np.float64)
+    a[:, :7] = q_targets
+    a[:, 7] = grip
+    a[:, 12] = -1.0  # arm mode; keep the mobile base and torso still
+    return a
+
+
+def ramp(q_start, q_goal, n=24, settle=6):
+    """A short smooth joint-space move with a few settling steps."""
+    count = max(1, n - settle)
+    return np.asarray(
+        [q_start + (q_goal - q_start) * min(1.0, (i + 1) / count)
+         for i in range(n)],
+        dtype=np.float64,
+    )
+
+
+def world_from_pixel(obs, u, v):
+    """Unproject one camera depth pixel into the calibrated world frame."""
+    depth = float(obs.depth[CAM][0, int(v), int(u)])
+    if not np.isfinite(depth) or depth <= 0:
+        raise RuntimeError("selected stop-button pixel has no valid depth")
+    camera = obs.meta["cameras"][CAM]
+    K = np.asarray(camera["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=np.float64)
+    T = np.asarray(camera["cam2world_gl"], dtype=np.float64)
+    x = (u - K[0, 2]) * depth / K[0, 0]
+    y_cv = (v - K[1, 2]) * depth / K[1, 1]
+    # OpenGL camera coordinates look along -z and have +y upward.
+    return (T @ np.array([x, -y_cv, -depth, 1.0]))[:3]
+
+
+def ee_and_q(meta):
+    now = np.asarray(meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float64)
+    return now[26:29].copy(), now[4:11].copy()
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    dt = float(spec["control_dt"])
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[CAM], include_depth=True, video="none")
+    e0, q0 = ee_and_q(obs.meta)
+
+    # Visually selected center of the lower-left green stop/cancel control.
+    # The image pixel is immediately converted using this observation's depth
+    # and calibration; the resulting world point is the button face.
+    button = world_from_pixel(obs, 210, 48)
+
+    def submit(q_path, note):
+        return robot.submit(
+            "joint_position",
+            command_rows(q_path),
+            interpolate="hold",
+            cameras=[CAM],
+            video="none",
+            note=note,
+        )
+
+    def calibrate(q_base):
+        # Small reversible positive joint perturbations, eight control steps
+        # each.  Proprioception reports actual q and world-frame eef xyz.
+        rows = []
+        for j in range(7):
+            q_probe = q_base.copy()
+            q_probe[j] += 0.08
+            rows.extend([q_probe.copy() for _ in range(8)])
+            rows.extend([q_base.copy() for _ in range(8)])
+        result = robot.submit(
+            "joint_position",
+            command_rows(rows),
+            interpolate="hold",
+            cameras=[],
+            video_fps=30,
+            video="none",
+            note="reversible joint perturbations for local visual-servo Jacobian",
+        )
+        samples = result.proprio
+        J = np.zeros((3, 7), dtype=np.float64)
+        for j in range(7):
+            lo = 16 * j
+            hi = min(lo + 8, len(samples))
+            i = lo + int(np.argmax(np.abs(samples[lo:hi, 4 + j] - q_base[j])))
+            dq = float(samples[i, 4 + j] - q_base[j])
+            if abs(dq) < 1e-4:
+                raise RuntimeError("joint perturbation was not observed")
+            J[:, j] = (samples[i, 26:29] - samples[lo, 26:29]) / dq
+        e, q = ee_and_q(result.meta)
+        return J, e, q
+
+    def servo_to(goal, J, e, q, max_iter=10):
+        # Refit the local mapping as the arm changes configuration.  Limit each
+        # update so that a single estimate cannot cause a large swing.
+        for _ in range(max_iter):
+            error = np.asarray(goal, dtype=np.float64) - e
+            if np.linalg.norm(error) < 0.025:
+                break
+            dq = np.linalg.pinv(J) @ error
+            peak = float(np.max(np.abs(dq)))
+            if peak > 0.18:
+                dq *= 0.18 / peak
+            result = submit(ramp(q, q + dq, n=24, settle=6), "short Cartesian approach step")
+            e, q = ee_and_q(result.meta)
+            J, e, q = calibrate(q)
+        return J, e, q
+
+    # Approach from in front of the microwave, keeping the gripper open.
+    stage = button + np.array([0.038, -0.087, 0.0])
+    J, e, q = calibrate(q0)
+    J, e, q = servo_to(stage, J, e, q)
+
+    # Align with the stop-button center just in front of its face, then press
+    # through the face plane.  The arm's native contact constraints limit the
+    # final travel when the button/panel is reached.
+    precontact = button + np.array([0.0, -0.05, 0.0])
+    J, e, q = servo_to(precontact, J, e, q)
+    J, e, q = calibrate(q)
+    press_goal = button + np.array([0.0, 0.013, 0.0])
+    dq = np.linalg.pinv(J) @ (press_goal - e)
+    peak = float(np.max(np.abs(dq)))
+    if peak > 0.18:
+        dq *= 0.18 / peak
+    press = submit(ramp(q, q + dq, n=20, settle=6), "press microwave stop button")
+    _, q = ee_and_q(press.meta)
+
+    # Retreat to the observed starting arm posture.  Its measured gripper site
+    # is more than 0.15 m from the button, leaving the terminal state safe.
+    retreat = submit(ramp(q, q0, n=40, settle=8), "retreat after button contact")
+    print("final eef:", ee_and_q(retreat.meta)[0].round(3))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
